name: House of Habib
desc: Karachi-based family conglomerate with stakes in Toyota Indus, HabibMetro bank, Thal, Agriauto, Habib Insurance, sugar, rice and tiles.
products: Toyota vehicles (Indus Motor), auto parts (Agriauto, Thal), banking (HabibMetro, Habib Bank AG Zurich), insurance, sugar, rice, tiles
marketing_autonomy_basis: family-run group holding; several member companies are separately listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange
markets: Mainly Pakistan; Habib Bank AG Zurich operates internationally from Switzerland
fit_rationale: Pakistani group whose Toyota Indus and auto-parts businesses tie it to automotive; hospitality could serve Toyota and Japanese partner relationships, but no Grand Prix serves Pakistan.
category_conflict: potential: group distributes Toyota vehicles; Toyota (TGR) partners Haas
f1_markets: none directly (Pakistan); Gulf races (Bahrain, Abu Dhabi, Saudi Arabia, Qatar) nearest

access.roles: Group chairman; group director corporate affairs

outstanding: Revenue year and basis (Wikipedia has citation tags); which listed member companies would fund a group-level deal; the master holds HABIB Group (Habib Jewels, Malaysia), a different company.

name: Belle Tire
desc: Midwest US chain of more than 180 tyre and auto-service stores selling tyres and wheels, repairs, alignments and auto glass.
products: Tyres, wheels, auto repair, oil changes, alignment, auto glass
customers: Car owners in Michigan, Indiana, Ohio and Illinois
marketing_autonomy_basis: owner-run (Barnes family) until the pending sale

alt_indicators.evidence: sponsor of the Detroit Tigers, Detroit Red Wings, Chicago Blackhawks and Indiana Pacers

sponsorships.rights_holder: Detroit Tigers; Detroit Red Wings; Chicago Blackhawks; Indiana Pacers

signals.what: Agreed in July 2026 to be acquired by Big Brand Tire & Service (owned by Percheron Capital); closing expected Q3 2026

fit_rationale: Regional Midwest tyre retailer with a sports-sponsorship habit but no Grand Prix in its four states; a pending PE-backed merger makes a global F1 deal unlikely before integration.
category_conflict: potential: Pirelli is F1's official tyre supplier (Belle Tire is a retailer, not a manufacturer)
f1_markets: United States (Miami, Austin, Las Vegas) only nationally; none in its four states
outstanding: Revenue not published; whether the Big Brand Tire deal has closed and who controls marketing after it.

name: Merbag
desc: Family-owned Swiss Mercedes-Benz dealer group with 64 sites across Switzerland, Germany, Austria, Italy and Luxembourg.
products: New and used Mercedes-Benz, AMG, Maybach, smart cars, trucks (Euro Truck), FUSO and Unimog; servicing; real estate
customers: Private and fleet car buyers, commercial-vehicle operators
marketing_autonomy_basis: family holding, but retail marketing is tied to the Mercedes-Benz brand
stores_or_sites: 64 locations (28 CH, 20 DE, 6 Vienna area, 5 IT, 5 LU)
markets: Switzerland, Germany, Austria (Vienna), Italy and Luxembourg
fit_rationale: Mercedes-Benz retailer in five European markets; Mercedes-AMG F1 hospitality would suit premium buyers, but any deal would sit within Mercedes' own F1 programme and brand rules.
category_conflict: established: sells Mercedes-Benz, which owns the Mercedes-AMG F1 team; other car brands are F1 teams too

access.roles: Chair of the board (Stüber family); CEO; head of marketing

outstanding: Whether Merbag can buy rights outside Mercedes-AMG; current CEO; listing status not stated on page (family AG, assumed unlisted).
